errors.duplicate_key: Record with this value already exists.
errors.error_creating_record: An error occurred while saving the record.

hints.display_name: Label shown to users in the filter dropdown on the list page.
hints.feature_name: The route name (e.g. a named route's route_name), not the table. Scopes this filter to one specific route when several routes share the same table.
hints.is_default: When set, this filter is applied automatically on the list page until the user picks a different one.
hints.module_code: Restricts this filter to routes belonging to the selected module. Leave unset to make it available module-wide.
hints.scope_key: Translation key. Not shown to users - keep it short and stable once in use.
hints.sort_order: Position in the filter dropdown, lowest first. Filters sharing a table/route are listed by this value ascending.
hints.table: The database table this filter applies to. Determines which index/edit pages show it in the filter dropdown.
hints.where_clause: Raw SQL condition appended after WHERE when this filter is active (e.g. status = 'active'). Use the ::session.* tokens below to reference the logged-in user. Unauthenticated access to a clause using them resolves to 1=0.
